Extract CLIP text features from text strings

Source: R/clip_text_features.R
clip_text_features.Rd

Encodes text strings using a CLIP model and returns embeddings from specified layers of the text transformer.

Usage

clip_text_features(
  texts,
  layers = "final",
  model_name = "ViT-B-32",
  num_text_transformer_blocks = 12,
  text_module_prefix = "transformer",
  device = c("cpu", "cuda")
)

Arguments

texts

Character vector of text strings to encode.

layers

Character or integer vector. "final" (default) returns the final CLIP text embeddings. For intermediate transformer layers, provide full layer names (e.g., "transformer.resblocks.6") or integer indices (0-based) representing transformer blocks. Other layer names (e.g., "token_embedding", "ln_final") can also be specified if known.

model_name

CLIP model string (e.g. "ViT-B-32", "RN50", "ViT-L-14").

num_text_transformer_blocks

Integer, number of transformer blocks in the text model. Defaults to 12 (e.g., for ViT-B/32 text transformer). Only relevant if integer indices are used for `layers`.

text_module_prefix

Character string, the base path to the text model's transformer blocks. Defaults to "transformer".

device

"cpu" or "cuda".

Value

A named list of numeric arrays (one per requested layer). `out$final` will be a matrix (N_texts x EmbeddingDim). Intermediate layers will be 3D arrays (N_texts x SeqLen x HiddenDim).
